head.badTitle: The list «What should not be here» under the scheme

title: Who knows whom
lead: Four layers. What is not on the scheme should not be there.

tags.title: System vocabulary
tags.note: Everyone knows it, it knows no one

called.title: Shared effects
called.note: They are called. They listen to no one and do not know who will call them

action.title: Actions
action.note: By button. They call shared effects by name and carry marks from the vocabulary

hanging.title: Hanging
hanging.note: They fire on their own. They know only the vocabulary

layer.hangingSide: they listen only to the vocabulary

between.none: there are no arrows between hanging effects and actions: they connect only through the vocabulary

tag.counts: carried by {{carries}} · heard by {{hears}} · edited by {{edits}}

panel.title: Links
panel.hint: Pick an effect or a mark on the scheme: its links will show here.

leaks.title: What should not be here
leaks.none: no extra links: everything goes through the vocabulary
leaks.byName: the subscription of effect «{{effect}}» listens to effect «{{of}}» by name — better listen to a mark
leaks.inner: the subscription «{{effect}}» reads the steps of «{{of}}»: {{names}}
leaks.silent: no one hears or edits the mark «{{tag}}»
